source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load Washer CG71 Family (WA7000A) (WA55CG71, WA55CG75, WA54CG)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Detergent drawer fully closed
steps.body: Close the detergent drawer until it clicks. SDC displays when the drawer is not completely closed before start.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Close the detergent drawer until it clicks. SDC displays when the drawer is not completely closed before start.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Close drawer until click and clear detergent buildup in track.

steps.title: Close detergent drawer
steps.oemOutcome: Seat drawer until click; remove debris blocking closure.

steps.title: Drawer OK
steps.oemOutcome: Detergent drawer closes and latches — retest cycle.
